note: runDemo copies a demo from external flash (linker_stExtFlash + 0x300400) into the user memory and runs it - and a demo need never return. So the row first reads that header with dump -S and goes no further unless the flash is erased; only then is runDemo safe to call.

tests.note: if a demo is installed, the header is not erased, the guard fails and runDemo is never started
